exposure: knowledge of labor and its stages
fear of damage to the infant
confidence in the ability to give birth
common social beliefs about natural delivery
cohort: The study included 473 nulliparous pregnant women in Amol, Iran.
finding: Various individual, family, and social factors, including communication skills, dyadic adjustment, age, socioeconomic status, and different forms of support, were significantly related to fear of childbirth.
mod_finding: Fear of childbirth is associated with adverse consequences such as a high rate of elective cesarean section.
